name: Auto Computation - Leave Listing & Approvals (Leave List)

parameters.query:
={{ $json.action === 'APPROVE' ? `
WITH target_req AS (
  SELECT id, employee_id, leave_type, days_count, start_date
  FROM leave_requests
  WHERE id = '` + $json.requestId + `'
  LIMIT 1
),
upd_req AS (
  UPDATE leave_requests
  SET 
    status = 'APPROVED',
    approved_or_rejected_by = '` + $json.callerName + `',
    reviewed_on = CURRENT_DATE,
    comments = '` + $json.escapedComment + `'
  WHERE id = '` + $json.requestId + `'
  RETURNING *
),
upd_bal AS (
  UPDATE leave_balances b
  SET used = b.used + tr.days_count
  FROM target_req tr
  WHERE b.employee_id = tr.employee_id
    AND b.leave_type = tr.leave_type
    AND b.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tr.start_date)::INT
  RETURNING b.*
),
ins_notif AS (
  INSERT INTO notifications (
    id, employee_id, category, title, message, action_route, priority, is_read
  )
  SELECT 
    '` + $json.notifId + `',
    tr.employee_id,
    'LEAVE_UPDATE',
    'Leave Request Approved',
    'Your leave application (` + $json.requestId + `) has been approved by HR.',
    '/(tabs)/leave',
    'HIGH',
    FALSE
  FROM target_req tr
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT 
  row_to_json(r.*) AS leave_request,
  row_to_json(b.*) AS updated_balance
FROM upd_req r
LEFT JOIN upd_bal b ON true;
` : ($json.action === 'RESET' || $json.action === 'PENDING') ? `
WITH target_req AS (
  SELECT id, employee_id, leave_type, days_count, start_date, status
  FROM leave_requests
  WHERE id = '` + $json.requestId + `'
  LIMIT 1
),
upd_req AS (
  UPDATE leave_requests
  SET 
    status = 'PENDING',
    approved_or_rejected_by = NULL,
    reviewed_on = NULL,
    comments = 'Pending management review'
  WHERE id = '` + $json.requestId + `'
  RETURNING *
),
upd_bal AS (
  UPDATE leave_balances b
  SET used = GREATEST(0, b.used - tr.days_count)
  FROM target_req tr
  WHERE tr.status = 'APPROVED'
    AND b.employee_id = tr.employee_id
    AND b.leave_type = tr.leave_type
    AND b.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tr.start_date)::INT
  RETURNING b.*
)
SELECT 
  row_to_json(r.*) AS leave_request,
  row_to_json(b.*) AS updated_balance
FROM upd_req r
LEFT JOIN upd_bal b ON true;
` : `
WITH target_req AS (
  SELECT id, employee_id
  FROM leave_requests
  WHERE id = '` + $json.requestId + `'
  LIMIT 1
),
upd_req AS (
  UPDATE leave_requests
  SET 
    status = 'REJECTED',
    approved_or_rejected_by = '` + $json.callerName + `',
    reviewed_on = CURRENT_DATE,
    comments = '` + $json.escapedComment + `'
  WHERE id = '` + $json.requestId + `'
  RETURNING *
),
ins_notif AS (
  INSERT INTO notifications (
    id, employee_id, category, title, message, action_route, priority, is_read
  )
  SELECT 
    '` + $json.notifId + `',
    tr.employee_id,
    'LEAVE_UPDATE',
    'Leave Request Rejected',
    'Your leave application (` + $json.requestId + `) has been rejected. Note: ' || '` + $json.escapedComment + `',
    '/(tabs)/leave',
    'HIGH',
    FALSE
  FROM target_req tr
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT 
  row_to_json(r.*) AS leave_request,
  NULL AS updated_balance
FROM upd_req r;
` }}

WITH 
balances_query AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    employee_id,
    leave_type AS "type",
    label,
    total::FLOAT,
    used::FLOAT,
    available::FLOAT,
    year
  FROM leave_balances
  WHERE (
    '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}' = 'ALL'
    OR employee_id = '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}'
  )
  AND year = {{ $json.year }}
  ORDER BY id ASC
),
requests_query AS (
  SELECT 
    r.id,
    r.employee_id AS "employeeId",
    COALESCE(e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name, r.employee_id) AS "employeeName",
    COALESCE(e.designation, 'Staff') AS "designation",
    e.avatar_url AS "avatarUrl",
    r.leave_type AS "leaveType",
    r.duration_type AS "durationType",
    r.start_date::TEXT AS "startDate",
    r.end_date::TEXT AS "endDate",
    r.days_count::FLOAT AS "daysCount",
    r.reason,
    r.status,
    r.applied_on::TEXT AS "appliedOn",
    r.approved_or_rejected_by AS "approvedOrRejectedBy",
    r.reviewed_on::TEXT AS "reviewedOn",
    r.comments,
    r.whatsapp_notice_acknowledged AS "whatsappNoticeAcknowledged",
    r.created_at::TEXT AS "createdAt"
  FROM leave_requests r
  LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = r.employee_id
  WHERE (
    '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}' = 'ALL'
    OR r.employee_id = '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}'
  )
  AND (
    '{{ $json.statusFilter }}' = 'ALL'
    OR r.status = '{{ $json.statusFilter }}'
  )
  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(b.*), '[]'::json) FROM balances_query b) AS balances,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(rq.*), '[]'::json) FROM requests_query rq) AS requests;
